title: Theo and the Will
author: Paloma Eriksen
blurb: Gideon Underhill, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
